notes.title: v1.04 Released
notes.content:
Just a small update:

[list]
[*] Fixed some Russian text on the arcade panels (thanks to a great user's input!)
[*] Added some art to the right arcade panel
[*] Changed the behavior of enemy missiles
[/list]

Now get out there and save the last colony!

notes.title: v1.01 released - Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
Version 1.01 of Destroyer: Invasion has been released!

1.01 adds 10 Steam achievements to challenge you. If you already have any Awards in-game, the Steam achievements should be automatically awarded when you launch the game.

Enjoy saving the last of humanity!
